summary: This manuscript reports a fully preregistered, archived paired experiment (n=200 paired intents) comparing a single LLM initial candidate (gpt-5-mini) observed without gating versus the same shared initial candidate evaluated by a deterministic NetOps verifier+gate (with up to one automated repair). Execution artifacts show all 200 paired episodes were valid under both conditions (n11=200; no discordant pairs), producing a preregistered paired difference = 0.0 (exact two-sided p=1.0). The authors correctly document shared_initial_candidate semantics, preregistration fidelity, archived artifacts/hashes, and realistic limitations. The study is a careful, narrow, confirmatory null result that is internally consistent and reproducible from the supplied evidence bundle.
critical_issues: References not presented as a conventional IEEE numbered bibliography with full bibliographic metadata; manuscript evidence lists DOIs/arXiv identifiers but the References section must use standard IEEE numbered citations and each cited record must support the proximate claims.
required_revisions: Replace any bare DOI/arXiv/identifier-only reference entries with full IEEE-style numbered bibliographic entries (authors, title, venue, year, DOI/arXiv ID where applicable). Ensure in-text citation markers are IEEE numeric brackets (e.g., [1]) and that each cited source actually supports the nearby claim; update manuscript reference list accordingly using only metadata verifiable from the archived reference records.

Add one explicit, unambiguous sentence in the Abstract and repeat in the Methods (end of design subsection) that states: baseline and guarded conditions reused the identical sampled initial candidate (shared_initial_candidate), therefore the confirmatory estimand measures only validator/repair/gate effects on that same candidate and does not measure effects of independent guarded-conditioned regenerations or prompt-template interventions. (This clarification must be present verbatim in Abstract and Methods so readers cannot misinterpret the measured estimand.)
optional_revisions: Add a brief explanatory paragraph (1–2 sentences) in Results interpreting the bootstrap CI [0.0,0.0] in the context of identical paired outcomes and noting its practical implication for detectable effects given zero discordant pairs.

Consider adding a short table mapping key claims in the Introduction/Related Work to the specific numbered references that substantiate them to strengthen citation semantics and reviewer traceability.
